comparison_basis: Before is the preserved reviewed output. Each retrospective variant is compared with the original same-named exclusion without the retrospective_ prefix; these new labels had no separate published before value. Original flags combined default-cabin proxies, snapshot screens and dated events through September 12. After primary screens use measurement horizons; unavailable screens retain baseline units. After retrospective screens use cabin metadata plus horizon-dated events. No historical freshness is inferred.

firenze_suite_freshness.note: Cabin snapshot freshness; historical freshness unavailable. Chart age is separate.
